rule: Sword Manor is a permanent military troop house under House Tang. It is not a public school and has no mobilize/stand-down state. Its conserved personnel remain in standing formations; internal training develops those same troops.
command_accounting: Top field/rank/unit commander and deputy billets are outside fighting troop strength. Embedded 1,000/500/100 command echelons are conserved bodies inside the relevant troop strength.
growth_rule: No artificial headcount cap. Growth requires conserved recruits, internal selection/training, real vacancies or new formations, officers, equipment, housing, food, and physical training capacity.
